settings.poll_seconds.label: Poll interval
settings.poll_seconds.description: Seconds between sysfs/UPower polls. Shared by every widget of this plugin. Devices read over hidraw (Steam Controller, 2.4GHz mice) report on their own schedule.
settings.notify.label: Notify on
settings.notify.description: Pop up a notification when a peripheral comes or goes. What's already connected at login is never announced.
settings.quiet.label: Don't notify for
settings.quiet.description: One SUBSTRING per entry, matched like the widget's device list. Devices that match come and go without a popup -- the hooks below still run.
settings.on_connect.label: On connect
settings.on_connect.description: Shell command run when a peripheral appears, e.g. `hey hook -f on-peripheral-connect "$model"`. Available: $event, $device, $model, $vendor, $serial, $native, $path, $percent, $state.
settings.on_disconnect.label: On disconnect
settings.on_disconnect.description: As above, when a peripheral vanishes. $percent is its last known charge.
settings.devices.label: Devices
settings.devices.description: One entry per device, drawn in this order: `SUBSTRING=GLYPH`, where SUBSTRING matches any part of the device's model, serial, kernel name, UPower path, or vendor, and GLYPH is a Tabler icon name (default battery-vertical). Devices that aren't connected take up no space.
settings.show_label.label: Show percentage
settings.warn_below.label: Warning threshold
settings.warn_below.description: At or below this charge, unplugged, the widget is in its "low" state -- error red by default. See the color settings.
settings.full_at.label: Full threshold
settings.full_at.description: Plugged in and at or above this charge counts as charged. UPower's own fully-charged state counts regardless.
settings.show_charge_glyph.label: Show charge glyph
settings.show_charge_glyph.description: A second, smaller glyph after the meter while plugged in.
settings.charging_glyph.label: Charging glyph
settings.charged_glyph.label: Charged glyph
settings.charging_glyph_color.label: Glyph color (charging)
settings.charging_glyph_color.descriptio: Plugged in, below the full threshold. Default inherits the widget's foreground.
settings.charging_meter_color.label: Meter color (charging)
settings.charging_meter_color.descriptio: Plugged in, below the full threshold. Default is on_surface.
settings.charging_label_color.label: Percentage color (charging)
settings.charging_label_color.descriptio: Plugged in, below the full threshold. Default inherits the widget's foreground.
settings.charged_glyph_color.label: Glyph color (charged)
settings.charged_glyph_color.description: Plugged in, at or above the full threshold. Default inherits the widget's foreground.
settings.charged_meter_color.label: Meter color (charged)
settings.charged_meter_color.description: Plugged in, at or above the full threshold. Default is on_surface.
settings.charged_label_color.label: Percentage color (charged)
settings.charged_label_color.description: Plugged in, at or above the full threshold. Default inherits the widget's foreground.
settings.discharging_glyph_color.label: Glyph color (discharging)
settings.discharging_glyph_color.descrip: Unplugged (or no state reported, as with Bluetooth headsets), above the warning threshold. Default inherits the widget's foreground.
settings.discharging_meter_color.label: Meter color (discharging)
settings.discharging_meter_color.descrip: Unplugged (or no state reported, as with Bluetooth headsets), above the warning threshold. Default is on_surface.
settings.discharging_label_color.label: Percentage color (discharging)
settings.discharging_label_color.descrip: Unplugged (or no state reported, as with Bluetooth headsets), above the warning threshold. Default inherits the widget's foreground.
settings.low_glyph_color.label: Glyph color (low)
settings.low_glyph_color.description: Unplugged, at or below the warning threshold. Default is error.
settings.low_meter_color.label: Meter color (low)
settings.low_meter_color.description: Unplugged, at or below the warning threshold. Default is error.
settings.low_label_color.label: Percentage color (low)
settings.low_label_color.description: Unplugged, at or below the warning threshold. Default is error.
settings.meter_width.label: Meter width
settings.meter_height.label: Meter height
settings.meter_height.description: In pixels. The bar capsule clips anything taller than the bar.
settings.gap.label: Spacing
settings.gap.description: In pixels, between the glyph, meter, and percentage alike.
settings.device_gap.label: Spacing between devices
settings.device_gap.description: In pixels, between one device's meter and the next.
